# GlobalSync AI

> Free time zone converter, meeting planner, world clock, and live currency exchange rates for remote teams and freelancers. No signup required.

## Tools
- [Time Zone Converter](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/time-zone-converter): Compare live time across 25+ cities, with DST handling via the IANA database.
- [Meeting Planner](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/meeting-planner): Find fair overlap hours for distributed teams.
- [Currency Converter](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/currency-converter): 160+ currencies at live mid-market rates.
- [Freelancer Rate Calculator](https://www.globalsync-ai.com/freelancer-rate-converter): Convert hourly/retainer/project rates to W-2 salary equivalent.
